name: balloons_move_off_the_bill_of_materials
why: NOTE 101, §16 (02/11/2026). «balloons» moves a balloon born over something to a free place (library 0.198.0), but up to library 0.198.5 the things in its way were the notes, the balloons, the other views and the title block, not the tables: a balloon born over the bill of materials stayed there. On 26M000002 with its view 70 mm lower and «layout: below», the four balloons sat on the header of the table with library 0.198.5 and went just above it with 0.198.6 (drawings d19 and d20).
defect_caught: A balloon left over the bill of materials, because the tables of the sheet are not in the way of a balloon.
_why_these_numbers: The assembly of «bom_over_the_title_block_and_balloons_again»: a base and a cover. The bill of materials rests on the title block, its top at y 79,21 mm, 217..413 mm across (read on the bench, 02/11/2026). The side view V3 (outline 91,8 x 25,8 mm) is taken off its line and centred at 315 / 100 mm: its outline ends at 87,1 mm, 7,9 mm above the table, and AutoBalloon lays the balloons of «below» about 10 mm under the outline (26M000002: 100,99 -> 90,98 mm), so they are born over the table.

the table where the owner puts it, and where the balloons will be born
